card.name: Past-state words after relative pronouns
card.fires_on: Words like was, been, expected, or original that come right after 'had', 'that', 'where it' and refer back to an earlier state or earlier event. Fires where the text is about what was previously the case.

modes.label: Resume prior dose
modes.description: The word 'was' after 'that' or 'it' when a dose goes back to what it was before.

modes.description: A past participle after 'had' in a narrative, describing an earlier state.
modes.example: we captured a Mexican colonel, who had<< been>> wounded, and a few men.
